widgets_values:
Analyze this video shot for reference-to-video generation.

In two sections following this format:

```
summary:
Scene description

detailed_description:
Action description
```

Only a couple of sentences per section, be concise.

First section:
- environment and background
- camera framing, angle, and movement
- lighting

Second section:
- The actions being done over time.
- Refer to the woman as <Subject 1>
- Refer to the man or the other person as <Subject 2>, but only if visible
- Don't describe the subjects, their appearance, their clothing,  only refers them as <Subject 1> or <Subject 2>
- Don't infer things if not clear; e.g.: "appears/suggesting to be laughing". Only describe facts.
- Don't describe things that don't happen, only facts that happen.
- Be very simple, describe just what is going on, the rough position of things and the rough animations.


Very important hint: {a}
